# EMERGENT - AI Agent Global Instructions

EMERGENT is a single-developer college project: a single-server LAN coding game platform where users write autonomous bots to play games against other bots(prewritten bots as well as other user submitted bots). This file contains the core directives and architectural principles that govern the entire codebase. For module-specific instructions, refer to the individual files in `docs/instructions/`.

## Core Directives
1. Keep it simple but functional. Prefer pragmatic single-server solutions over cloud-style complexity.
2. Keep game logic modular. New games must be addable without rewriting orchestration.
